نستعين بخدمات تقنية خارج سورية، ولا نرسل:
We use technical services outside Syria and send them only what they need to work:
• Anthropic: runs the AI assistant.
• Twilio and WhatsApp: verification codes and alerts (phone number and message text).
• Google Firebase: app notifications (device token and notification text).
• Google and Facebook: if you sign in with them, we receive your name and email from them.
• Email service: account and order emails.

يحق لك طلب إرجاع منتج خلال 7 أيام من است: You can request a return within 7 days of delivery, from the order page under "My orders". Choose the reason (damaged, not as described, wrong size or colour, changed my mind, or other) and add a description and photos.
يرد البائع خلال 3 أيام بالموافقة أو الرف: The seller answers within 3 days, approving or refusing with a reason; without an answer the request goes to the platform team automatically. If the seller refuses, you can dispute within 7 days and the platform team decides.
بعد الموافقة أعد المنتج خلال 14 يوماً بح: Once approved, send the item back within 14 days in the condition you received it, with its accessories. If it does not arrive in time, the request is closed.
بعد استلام المنتج المُرجَع تردّ إدارة ال:
Once the returned item is received, the platform team refunds you and tells you how the refund was made.
• The delivery fee is refunded when the whole order is returned because it was damaged or not as described.
• Loyalty points you earned are taken back in proportion to the refund.
• If the whole order is returned, the coupon you used on it is given back.
البائع يرد أولاً على طلب الإرجاع، وإدارة: The seller answers a return request first; the platform team decides disputes or when the seller does not answer, and only the platform team refunds money.
